items.headline: Shenzhen me APEC CEO Summit, 12 neta aayenge
items.detail: CCPIT ne aaj elaan kiya ki 17-18 November ko Shenzhen me hone wale APEC CEO Summit me Xi Jinping samet 12 arthvyavasthaon ke neta bhashan denge ya panel charcha me hissa lenge; 115 Fortune Global 500 companiyon ke pratinidhi bhi aayenge.
items.exam_angle: APEC aur Asia-Pacific me vyapar sahyog — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Timor-Leste 2029 me ASEAN ki adhyakshata karega
items.detail: ASEAN Coordinating Council ne faisla kiya ki Timor-Leste 2029 me ASEAN ki adhyakshata karega — Singapore 2027 me, Thailand 2028 me, phir Vietnam; Myanmar ki daavedari baad me vichari jayegi.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN adhyakshata chakr aur Timor-Leste, sabse naya sadasya — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bahrain: Iran ka US base par drone hamla
items.detail: Bahrain me subah dhamake aur siren sunai diye; Iran ke Revolutionary Guards ne daava kiya ki unhone Riffa base par US radar ko chhah drones se nishana banaya — Bahrain ne kaha uski hawai suraksha ne kai hamle roke, abhi koi nuksan ki pushti nahi.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav aur Gulf me US sainya upasthiti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Manila me 49th ASEAN shikhar sammelan shuru
items.detail: Philippines ke Rashtrapati Marcos ne Manila me 49th ASEAN Summit ka udghatan kiya — vyapar, urja sankat, Myanmar aur South China Sea par charcha; Trump 17 November ko pahunchenge, Quad netaon se alag baithak bhi hogi.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, Bharat-ASEAN sambandh aur Quad — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Damascus: car bomb me pita-beti mare gaye
items.detail: Damascus ke Jaramana ilaake me shanivaar shaam car bomb phata — ek aadmi aur uski beti mare gaye, ek mahila ghayal; suraksha balon ne jaanch shuru ki, kisi ne zimmedari nahi li.
items.exam_angle: Syria me suraksha sthiti aur West Asia — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: WHO: type 1 diabetes par pehli guidelines
items.detail: WHO ne 14 November ko World Diabetes Day par vayaskon me type 1 diabetes ke liye pehli guidelines jaari ki — roz kai baar insulin injection aur sasti insulin tak pahunch par zor; duniya bhar me 95 lakh log isse peedit hain.
items.exam_angle: WHO, swasthya aur Bharat me diabetes bojh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: NATO: 2027 me Albania shikhar sammelan nahi
items.detail: NATO ne 2027 me Albania me netaon ka shikhar sammelan na karne ka faisla kiya, mantri-stariya baithaken bhi kam hongi; mahasachiv Rutte ne kaha shikhar sammelan tab hoga jab zaroorat hogi, 2028 me Tirana mezban ho sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: NATO aur Europe ki suraksha vyavastha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Philippines-Australia raksha samjhauta, 1995 deal update
items.detail: Manila me Philippines aur Australia ne Defence Cooperation Arrangement par hastakshar kiye — 1995 ke samjhaute ka update, sanyukt sainya abhyas aur aapda madad me tezi aayegi; PM Albanese ne samjhaute ko dekha.
items.exam_angle: Indo-Pacific me raksha sahyog aur ASEAN — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America me udaan sankat, hazaron flights radd
items.detail: FAA ke router kharabi se shukravaar ko lagbhag 9,200 flights radd hui, shanivaar ko 6,150 se zyada; ravivaar der raat tak haal normal hone ki ummeed — L3Harris ke router ki jaanch chal rahi hai.
items.exam_angle: America me havaai yatra sankat aur ATC vyavastha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Riyadh par Houthi missile, hawai suraksha ne roka
items.detail: Saudi gathbandhan ne ravivaar subah Riyadh ki taraf aaye Houthi ke do ballistic missile maar giraye; shanivaar ko bhi do drone nasht kiye gaye — 23 September se Houthi hamalon me Saudi me kam se kam 26 log mare gaye.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me tanav, Houthi hamle aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31: Antalya me hazaaron ka pradarshan
items.detail: Antalya me shanivaar ko hazaaron pradarshankariyon ne COP31 ke khilaf march kiya — police ke anusaar 7,000 se zyada log; vaarta aadhe raste par hai, jeevashm indhan aur vitt par matbhed barkaraar.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vaarta aur Bharat ki sthiti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kate aur William Mumbai aayenge, Earthshot 17 November
items.detail: Kensington Palace ne 14 November ko ghoshna ki — Prince William aur Kate Middleton 17 November ko Mumbai me Earthshot Prize samaroh me shamil honge; ye 2022 ke baad unki pehli sanyukt videsh yatra hai.
items.exam_angle: Earthshot Prize aur Bharat-Britain sambandh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz: teen tanker me aag, Iran ka daava
items.detail: Iran ki nausena ka daava hai ki Hormuz jalmarg me teen tel tanker samudri surang se takrakar aag me lapet gaye; swatantra pushti abhi nahi hui hai, aur America ke anusaar marg saaf kiya ja chuka hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jalmarg, Iran-America tanav aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas ke bade commander mare gaye
items.detail: Israel ke drone hamle me Hamas ki Rafah brigade ke commander Samir Abu Younis (53) Khan Younis me mare gaye; Hamas ne maut ki pushti ki, do log ghayal — October 2025 se lagu yuddhviram par dabav badha.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhviram aur Madhya-Purv me tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France me paanchve hafte bhi lakhon ka pradarshan
items.detail: France me shanivaar ko paanchve lagataar hafte mehangai aur police vidheyak ke khilaf pradarshan hue — grih mantralaya ke anusaar 1,06,000 log, aayojakon ke anusaar 2,00,000; mangalvaar ko phir hadtaal ka ailaan hai.
items.exam_angle: France me jan-andolan aur loktantra — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Starship pehli baar tower se pakda gaya
items.detail: SpaceX ka Starship 22 ghante aur 14 chakkar ke baad kaksha se lauta aur Texas me launch tower ki vishal baahnon ne use pehli baar pakad liya; booster wapas aane me nakaam raha aur samudra me gira.
items.exam_angle: Puri tarah dobara istemal ho sakne wala rocket — antariksh takneek aur Artemis mission ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Manila me ASEAN shikhar sammelan shuru
items.detail: Manila me 49th ASEAN shikhar sammelan shuru hua — Marcos Jr. ne udghatan samaroh ki adhyakshata ki aur Australia-Philippines raksha samjhote par hastakshar honge; vyapaar, suraksha aur urja sankat par charcha hogi, Trump 17 November ko ASEAN-America shikhar sammelan me shamil honge aur Quad deshon se bhi milenge.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, Quad aur Bharat ki Act East neeti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Macron: Ukraine madad ghatao to phir yuddh
items.detail: France ke rashtrapati Emmanuel Macron ne shanivaar ko kaha — Ukraine ki madad kam karna use 'anyaypoorn shanti' par majboor karega aur ye ek aur yuddh ki recipe hai; unhone Europe ki suraksha ke liye vittiya madad jaari rakhne ki maang ki.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur Europe ki suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Christophe Licoppe / European Union, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0)

items.headline: South Sudan: pehla chunav phir tala, February 2027
items.detail: South Sudan ne azadi ke baad ke pehle rashtriya chunav phir taale — 22 December ki jagah ab 11 February 2027 ko matdan hoga; chunav aayog ne wajah nahi batayi, aur taiyari ke liye maange gaye $276 million me se sirf $21 million mile hain.
items.exam_angle: Africa me loktantra aur chunav taiyari — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Stein Ove Korneliussen / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0)

items.headline: Italy ne Meta par €805 million jurmana
items.detail: Italy ke data regulator ne Facebook ko Android users ki gallery se bina anumati photo-video lene par €805 million (lagbhag $887 million) ka jurmana lagaya — lagbhag 2 crore users prabhavit hue, Meta ko 60 din me feature band karna hoga.
items.exam_angle: Data privacy, GDPR aur badi tech companies par niyaman — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Manila me Quad shikhar sammelan, 17 November
items.detail: Modi, Trump, Takaichi aur Albanese 17 November ki shaam Manila me milenge — 2024 ke baad pehla Quad shikhar sammelan, aur pehli baar kisi gair-Quad desh me; critical minerals aur samudri suraksha par baat hogi.
items.exam_angle: 2024 ke baad pehla Quad shikhar sammelan; Bharat ki adhyakshata aur Indo-Pacific sahyog — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bulgaria ne Ukraine ko hathiyar dena roka
items.detail: Bulgaria ke Rumen Radev ne Dublin me kaha — sena ke bhandar se Ukraine ko hathiyar nahi denge aur naye €70 arab ke EU package me bhi hissa nahi lenge; bajat ghaata wajah batayi, manaviya aur bijli madad jaari rahegi.
items.exam_angle: EU ki Ukraine madad me daraar aur bajat niyam — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Bulgarian Presidency, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.5 bg

items.headline: Pope Leo Peru laute, lakhon ne swagat kiya
items.detail: Pope Leo XIV Peru laut aaye — Lima me 30 lakh logon ne swagat kiya, Chiclayo me 15 lakh ki Mass hui, aur shanivaar ko Andes ke gaon me unhone garibi aur palayan par 'suffering' ki chetavani di.
items.exam_angle: Pope ka pehla Latin America daura; Vatican kootneeti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America ne Donbas-NATO sauda poocha, Zelenskyy ne bataya
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne bataya ki Abu Dhabi baatchit me America ne pehli baar poocha — NATO sadasyata mile to kya Ukraine Donbas se hat jayega; unhone kaha ilaka nahi chhodenge, lekin poori suraksha package mile to janmat sangrah kara sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur NATO vistaar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
